title: lobelia collaris
intro: Lobelia collaris, commonly known as Lobelia, is a flowering plant species within the family Campanulaceae. This plant is valued for its rich history in traditional medicine, where it has been used to treat a variety of ailments. The health benefits of Lobelia include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which have been found to reduce pain and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents present in Lobelia include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation and antiviral properties.
